title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): multichannel customer outreach across web chat, voice, SMS and email
summary: The briefing says the roadmap does not say who the agent contacts, but the record explicitly identifies customers. Its cautious treatment of undocumented defaults and controls is supported; licensing should distinguish the published Microsoft Copilot entitlement from unpublished feature-specific terms.

claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government, and education subscription plans.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included' for a new capability within the licensed product, as the standard requires for product-level licensing. This product requirement does not establish a feature-specific meter.
